name: Middle East Regional Risk Profile
description: The Middle East region faces elevated geopolitical risk driven by ongoing conflicts, proxy rivalries, and sanctions regimes. Oil infrastructure is a primary concern for multinational operations. Regulatory environments vary significantly by country.

name: Europe Regional Risk Profile
description: Europe faces elevated energy cost risks following supply disruptions, alongside regulatory headwinds from ESG mandates and digital sovereignty requirements. Eastern Europe has heightened security risk. Sanctions regimes against Russia continue to evolve.

name: Asia-Pacific Regional Risk Profile
description: Asia-Pacific presents strategic supply chain concentration risks, particularly in semiconductor fabrication (Taiwan) and pharmaceutical ingredient manufacturing (India, China). US-China trade tensions and Taiwan Strait dynamics are primary geopolitical risk factors.

name: North America Regional Risk Profile
description: North America is a comparatively stable operating environment. Primary risks include regulatory policy shifts, cyber threat actor activity targeting critical infrastructure, and trade policy uncertainty. Financial sector faces interest rate and credit cycle exposure.

name: Africa Regional Risk Profile
description: Africa presents variable operating conditions; North Africa faces ongoing conflict spillover risk and infrastructure gaps. Sub-Saharan Africa has significant resource extraction opportunities but governance and security challenges. Energy infrastructure is frequently targeted.
